correctness.rationale: Stationarity follows from positive occupation of the contracting state. Coupled stationary Fourier equations give the normalized transform; its unique Lévy profile h(r)=(a+1)e^-cr-e^-dr is positive and satisfies the Lévy integrability test. The established class-L monotonicity criterion gives if and only if (a+1)c>=d, algebraically beta(4mu+alpha)>=4mu^2, equality included. The nonnegative derivative density q=-hprime gives a finite-intensity compound-Poisson Lévy bath, whose OU stationary exponent recovers the exact transform. Below threshold h increases near zero, obstructing any Lévy-driven OU marginal equivalence. 112 independently executed finite checks include exact rational generator/Fourier even moments and Fourier quadrature.

value.rationale: The Markov-modulated harmonic diffusion is a motivated optical-trap/resetting model. Its stationary marginal is always infinitely divisible yet crosses a sharp parameter-specified boundary for genuine Lévy-driven OU emulation; the contrast is structural, depends on physical switching/relaxation rates but not diffusion, and admits an explicit positive jump bath in exactly the feasible region. That resolves a concrete equivalence/design classification absent from inspected source statements; novelty is not attributed to the previously known transform or general Sato theory. Risk: result may be judged a routine consequence of the 2017 transform and classical criterion.
